messages:
Anya: Quick async—shipping gates for Optimize Toolkit milestone tomorrow. Need owners + shadow plan. Quant recs PR (github.com/redwood/optimize#412) merged to staging but we saw two regressions in batch-cache path when running Llama-2-medium quantized. Anyone owning rollout window & shadow traffic run?

Mike: I can own the rollout window. I'll book 1.5h tomorrow 09:30-11:00 PT. @Sahil can you run shadow harness?

Sahil: Yep, I can run it. Which harness + dataset? Prefer to run 'conv-sim' set and the e2e latency smoke.

Anya: Use conv-sim + short prompts (max_len 256). Focus on tail latency p99 and generation correctness (token-level ROUGE). Primary concern: batching+KV cache regression on small-batch workloads.

Lisa: Noted. Heads-up: feature-flag toggles required for private clusters. @DeployBot please confirm flag states for staging.

DeployBot: staging:optkit_quant_recs=ON, staging:batch_cache_v2=ON, private:optkit_quant_recs=OFF

Sahil: Running harness now. Command:
```
./run_shadow.sh --env=staging --suite=conv-sim --model=llama2-medium-q4_0 --duration=30m
```
I'll stream logs to #eng-runtime/live-ops.

Mike: I'll coordinate traffic shaping and keep canary at 5% then step to 25% if smoke OK. If regress, rollback policy = immediate fallback to fp16 model variant.

Anya: Regression alert note: two flaky tests in presubmit referenced in PR comments — @Sahil can you capture failing sample prompts and paste gist? Also add any miscomp decoded tokens.

Sahil: Captured sample -> gist: https://gist.github.com/sahil/abc123. Failures are deterministic on small-batch sequence of length 128, appears in KV merge step.

Anya: Thanks. If we hit >2% accuracy drop or p99 latency +50ms, we abort. Otherwise proceed with canary step.

Lisa: I'll update the rollout doc and add owner tags. File: docs/release/optkit-milestones.md (edited)

Mike: All set on my side. Ping me in thread if you see regressions. :thumbsup:

Anya: Great—closing loop. Will post final gate status 30m before rollout.
